description: This file contains a Python class 'SubmissionService' that manages submission lifecycle, including creation, ensuring minimal test submissions, updating states, and retrieving submissions. It integrates with a database and other services like audit, draft, and auth, and defines methods for handling submission state transitions and related operations.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service for submission lifecycle and state machine management, providing methods to create, update, retrieve, and ensure test submissions.
